label: Hollow Knight: Silksong sandboxes
description: How Hollow Knight: Silksong sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: BepInEx itself is not a mod and is not installed here; unpack it into the game folder once (it hooks in through winhttp.dll).
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.
